title: Cosmic Eye Revelation
description: A surreal visionary painting depicts a giant all-seeing eye with a green iris and black dripping substance at the top, emitting a beam of light onto a multi-armed blue-skinned goddess reading a book. Below her is a fiery red pagoda, floating dragons, clouds, and a second giant green eye hovering above a body of water between red mountains, framed by theatrical red and blue curtains.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting featuring a giant red-veined eye with green iris at the top dripping black liquid, shining a golden beam of light downward. A blue-skinned four-armed goddess with long dark hair sits reading an ancient book, surrounded by floating faces with red fiery hair, lightning, a red Japanese pagoda, and two black dragons fighting with orange energy. A second large green eye floats above a lake between red rocky mountains. Dramatic red and blue curtains frame the scene like a theater, mystical and psychedelic atmosphere, highly detailed, vibrant colors.
